text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE original adult character for a coordinated 28-character premium romantic 3D CG collection. Style: high-end Chinese otome game / animated cinematic character modeling, subtly idealized sculpted facial anatomy, luminous smooth translucent skin with fine restrained microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, beautiful detailed eyes, individually groomed wispy hair strands, finely rendered fabric/metal. Clearly polished dimensional CG rather than a real-person photograph. NOT gritty, no coarse pores, no plastic doll sheen, no outlines. Scene: solid PURE WHITE #FFFFFF seamless background. Lighting: bright soft neutral frontal studio light with balanced fill, delicate facial modeling shadows, subtle luminous bloom, no dramatic darkness or colored backdrop. Composition: EXACT 1024x1536 portrait 2:3. A single centered frontal eye-level character, head upright shoulders level, looking at viewer; waist-up to lower chest portrait. Entire hair, head ornaments and shoulders visible with 8% blank white margin above topmost hair or ears. Same camera distance, head including hair around 40% of canvas height. 85mm-like perspective. Relaxed arms down, hands outside frame. Design a clearly new identity, not a replica of any known game character or reference portrait: specific distinct eye shape, nose, lips, jaw and proportions described below are crucial. All adults. No text, brands, watermarks, signature, frames, labels, collage or additional people.
Character design: Male age 24. Smoky ash-blond short spiky side-swept hair with darker roots. Dark rose-brown narrow eyes, compact oval face, wide forehead, curved thick brows, slightly broad nose tip, small cupid-bow lips, gently pointed but short chin. Peach beige skin. Small graphite ear studs and pale stone-gray textured hoodie without prints. Easygoing confident faint smile, eyes level.
reproduction_note: 已保留本次确认原图与实际生成记录；文字提示词未经复现验证，严格保持身份请使用本张身份母版。
